BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

2. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   D. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

7. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   C. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
